sisi.depan: Golden rice terraces ascend a steep hill to a distant, slender stone spire on the summit, which is flanked by a grove of towering banyan trees.
sisi.kanan: A village of wooden stilt houses with intricately carved gables and woven bamboo walls clusters along the mid-slope, nestled among the continuing terraces and a dense patch of coconut palms.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, the terraced slope descends sharply into a misty valley, where the wide, reflective surfaces of the lowest water-filled paddies are visible.
sisi.kiri: A multi-tiered waterfall tumbles down a dark rock face into a series of turquoise pools, with the hillside terraces curving around it and a lone, weathered stone footbridge crossing the main stream.

tengah: In the foreground, a series of bamboo irrigation pipes channels water along the edge of the current terrace, feeding into a small, moss-covered stone basin carved with geometric patterns.
atas: A vast, hazy sky glows with the warm, golden light of a low sun, casting long shadows and reflecting brilliantly off the water in the terraces.
